title: Persona-Driven Feedback Agents for High-Stakes Documents: A Multi-Perspective Evaluation of Global Talent Visa Submissions
venue: IEEE AAIML 2026 (International Conference on Advances in Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning), pp. 367–372
note: Co-authored research prototype: persona-based AI agents assess high-stakes application documents. Evaluated on 20 synthetic applications; no real-world outcome validation.

title: Adversarial Causal Deliberation among Autonomous Agents for Reliable Consumer Behaviour Explanation
note: Co-authored simulation study: agents with competing roles must challenge a causal claim before it is accepted. Accepted, not yet published.

title: CausalAgentBench: Reliability-Aware Benchmarking of Causal Reasoning, Coordination and Explainability in Multi-Agent Consumer Intelligence
note: Co-authored benchmark that scores the handoffs between components of a causal analytics pipeline, including corrupted inputs and abstention. Accepted, not yet published.
